title: Object References and Safety
introduction: Pointers refer to existing objects, so gameplay code must handle missing or invalid references safely.
learningOutcomes: Explain what a pointer and nullptr represent.
Check an Unreal object reference before use.
Recognise an Unreal-managed UObject property declaration.

activities.question: What should code do before calling a method through an optional Actor pointer?
options: Check that the pointer is valid
activities.explanation: An optional pointer may be null or no longer valid, so code must validate it before dereferencing it.

activities.question: Which modern C++ literal represents a null pointer?
activities.explanation: nullptr is the type-safe null pointer literal used when a pointer refers to no object.
